title: Build an AND circuit
description: Create a circuit whose output Y is 1 only when A and B are both 1.

title: AND into OR
description: Build Y = (A AND B) OR C.

title: NAND from AND and NOT
description: Build a NAND function using only AND and NOT gates: Y is 0 only when A and B are both 1.
hint: Invert the output of an AND gate.

title: XOR from AND, OR, NOT
description: Build Y = A XOR B (1 when exactly one input is 1) using AND, OR, and NOT gates.
hint: A XOR B = (A AND NOT B) OR (NOT A AND B).

title: Majority of three
description: Y is 1 when at least two of A, B, C are 1.
expected_expression: (A AND B) OR (A AND C) OR (B AND C)

title: 2-to-1 multiplexer
description: Y equals A when S is 0, and equals B when S is 1.
expected_expression: (A AND NOT S) OR (B AND S)

title: Half adder
description: Add two bits A and B. S is the sum bit and C is the carry bit.

title: Full adder
description: Add bits A, B and carry-in Cin. S is the sum bit and Cout the carry-out.

expected_outputs.Cout: (A AND B) OR (Cin AND (A XOR B))
